facts.fact: Jelka 在第一小时后停止祈祷，改为哼歌（Leah 觉得这更糟）
facts.anchor: Jelka stopped praying after the first hour and instead started humming

facts.fact: Matteo 手肘撞上通讯台一角并咒骂，说在这种玩具盒般的艇里能摔断脖子，Leah 出声让他别弄坏值钱东西
facts.anchor: Matteo caught his elbow on the corner of the comms deck and cursed

facts.fact: Leah 想到下潜到三万五千英尺时本应释放配重减速，但已无操作办法、也无法判断已下潜多深
facts.anchor: we’d need to release weights to slow our descent once we reached thirty-five thousand feet

facts.fact: Matteo 取出四把宽体电筒放在主舱底部四周，舱内重获照明
facts.anchor: Matteo brought out four wide electric torches

facts.fact: Leah 问「我们是不是该做点什么」，两人都不作声，Matteo 随后用牙缝吹口哨《Farewell and adieu to you fair Spanish ladies》
facts.anchor: Farewell and adieu to you fair Spanish ladies

facts.fact: 七岁时父亲把 Leah 的手指从市立泳池边掰开、扔进深水区教她游泳
facts.anchor: he wrenched my knuckles from the side of the municipal swimming pool and hurled me into the deep end

facts.fact: Leah 最爱 Thor Heyerdahl 乘手工木筏、仅五人横渡太平洋五千英里的故事
facts.anchor: sailed five thousand miles across the Pacific in a hand-built raft crewed only by five men

facts.fact: 结尾 Leah 屏住呼吸、想着尖叫，想象海洋走到尽头
facts.anchor: so I held my breath and thought about screaming and imagined the ocean coming to an end

relations.kind: 同舱难友：Leah 嫌她哼歌更糟，却压住话头、强迫自己善意以待
relations.anchor: Jelka stopped praying after the first hour and instead started humming

relations.kind: 同舱难友：Leah 主动帮他敲控制台，尽管这并非她的职责、也不会有用
relations.anchor: Matteo continued to batter vaguely at the console and I helped him

relations.kind: 父女：父亲以近乎狂热的「厌恶疗法」把她扔进深水区教会她游泳，后又教她水肺潜水
relations.anchor: My father taught me to swim and later to scuba-dive

relations.kind: 母女：母亲以日常物件照料她（UltraSwim 去氯洗发水），并向她解释离婚
relations.anchor: my mum bought me UltraSwim chlorine removal shampoo
